description: This file defines the interface for a SerialPort class used for serial communication, including configuration options, platform-specific implementations, and method declarations for opening, closing, and data transfer operations.

classes.name: SerialPort
classes.description: A class representing a serial port interface supporting platform-specific configurations and data transfer methods.

methods.name: SerialPort
methods.description: Default constructor for SerialPort class.

methods.name: SerialPort
methods.description: Constructor initializing serial port with specific parameters such as port name, baud rate, parity, data bits, stop bits, flow control, and buffer sizes.

methods.name: ~SerialPort
methods.description: Destructor for SerialPort class.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts a numeric speed value to a BaudRate enum.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the serial port with a specified wait time.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the serial port with a specified wait time.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers an event or action on the serial port.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Pure virtual method to send data through the serial port.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Pure virtual method to receive data from the serial port.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle state changes.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Configures the serial port with detailed parameters.

methods.name: SetBaudRate
methods.description: Sets the baud rate for the serial port.

methods.name: SendBreak
methods.description: Sends a break signal on the serial port.

methods.name: Construct
methods.description: Initializes internal buffers and state.

methods.name: Settings
methods.description: Applies the current configuration settings to the hardware.

methods.name: Opened
methods.description: Marks the port as open and updates state.

methods.name: Closed
methods.description: Marks the port as closed and releases resources.

methods.name: WaitForClosure
methods.description: Waits for the port to close within a specified timeout.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the port (platform-specific).

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the port (platform-specific).

methods.name: Descriptor
methods.description: Returns the handle to the port (platform-specific).
